page.layout: One page of text, title page: centred title lines, below them a vignette (engraving of a castle within an oval inscription band), two seals at the right, imprint at the foot. Library stamp at right and digitiser's watermark at lower right are not transcribed.

l.i: Cujus occasione Liber II. & III. Principiorum Philosophiæ
dicti des-Cartes maximam partem illustrantur: cum Indice.

main_text.l: Editio secunda à multis mendis emaculata & non parum aucta.

page.notes: The inscription band of the vignette reads SVPER LAPIDEM QVI RVET ISTA DOMVS STRVCTA, set around the oval; the order above follows the printed band, not reading order. The 1682 date is partly obscured by a stain at its end. Stamp "BIBLIOTECA NAZ. ROMA VITTORIO EMANUELE" and the "Digitized by Google" mark are not transcribed.
